article.headline: San Diego State edges New Mexico 64-62 in MWC semifinal, will play Utah State for championship
article.description: — Magoon Gwath had 17 points and BJ Davis made a layup with two seconds left to rally San Diego State to a 64-62 victory over New Mexico on Friday night in a Mountain West Conference Tournament semifinal.
article.linkText: San Diego State edges New Mexico 64-62 in MWC semifinal, will play Utah State for championship

categories.description: New Mexico Lobos @ San Diego State Aztecs

event.description: New Mexico Lobos @ San Diego State Aztecs

keywords: New Mexico Lobos @ San Diego State Aztecs
article.story: LAS VEGAS -- — Magoon Gwath had 17 points and BJ Davis made a layup with two seconds left to rally San Diego State to a 64-62 victory over New Mexico on Friday night in a Mountain West Conference Tournament semifinal. No. 2 seed San Diego State (22-10) will play top seed Utah State in Saturday's championship game with an automatic spot in the NCAA Tournament on the line. Gwath made 6 of 10 shots with two 3-pointers and 3 of 5 free throws for the Aztecs, adding six rebounds and two blocks. Davis totaled 12 points, six rebounds, six assists and three steals. Deyton Albury scored 20 on 7-for-10 shooting to pace the third-seeded Lobos (23-10). Uriah Tenette had 11 points and Tomisla Buljan grabbed 10 rebounds to go with eight points. Gwath had 10 points in the first half to help San Diego State take a 37-33 lead into intermission. Albury scored four straight points to pull New Mexico even at 62-all with 25 seconds remaining before Davis delivered the winner. ------ Get poll alerts and updates on the AP Top 25 throughout the season.
